preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the path length k must satisfy the given constraints.

postconditions.description: The first line of output should be the minimum number of colors needed.
The second line of output should contain exactly (n * (n - 1)) // 2 edge colors.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= c for color in edge_colors)
postconditions.description: All edge colors must be integers between 1 and c.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(edge_colors[i:i+k])) >= 2 for i in range((n * (n - 1)) // 2 - k + 1))
postconditions.description: All paths of length k or longer must be rainbow paths.
